title: Terminal plugin main.js code patches
why: Two code edits to the Polyipseity terminal plugin's bundled main.js that have no settings exposure. (1) Hotkey passthrough: while a terminal is focused the plugin re-bakes Obsidian's hotkey table to a hardcoded whitelist Set; we prepend the tab-switch (goto-tab/next/previous/last), close-tab, new-terminal, settings, and zen-mode command ids so those hotkeys still reach Obsidian instead of falling through to the shell. (2) Strip the 'Terminal: ' tab-title prefix by simplifying getDisplayText() to return the bare name. Reapply after any terminal plugin update.
